spec_version.description: Blueprint specification version: 2 (integer or string), or '2-preview'.

description.description: Optional but recommended free-text description of the blueprint, presented in the Torque UI and API.

environment.title: environment metadata
environment.description: Environment metadata for Environment-as-Code files (a saved environment definition) - not used in regular catalog blueprints.

display-name.description: A user-friendly display name shown in the Torque catalog instead of the blueprint file name.

self-service.title: Blueprint self-service
self-service.description: Whether the blueprint is published in the self-service catalog. Either a boolean, which applies to every space the repository is connected to, or a list of the space names to publish the blueprint in (space names are case insensitive, and spaces that are not listed are left unpublished). Once this field is set, it can no longer be changed through the API or the UI in any space.

estimated-ccu.description: Estimated cost of the blueprint in CCU units - a literal number (e.g. '5') or a reference to a blueprint input.

icon.title: Blueprint Icon
icon.description: A custom icon for the blueprint catalog item, from an image file in the repository.

blueprint-labels.description: Labels on the blueprint catalog item itself - a plain string or a {key, value} object. Different from 'labels', which are set on environments.

scope.description: Where the workflow is available: 'space' (space level), 'env' (entire environments) or 'env_resource' (specific resource types).

labels-selector.description: Attaches the workflow to blueprints or running environments with matching labels ('and' = all must match, ',' = any matches).

resource-types.description: For 'env_resource' scope: the resource types the workflow applies to, in CSV format (e.g. aws_instance).

timeout.description: Maximum duration in minutes the workflow may run before it is automatically terminated (minimum 5). Supports Liquid.

workflow.title: workflow metadata
workflow.description: Marks this YAML as a workflow (a day-2 operation run on environments or their resources) and configures where it applies and when it triggers.

instructions.title: instructions
instructions.description: The recommended way for the blueprint developer to communicate with the end user and explain how to use the blueprint - inline markdown 'text' or a markdown file from a repository ('source').

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: References a layout YAML from a repository, customizing how end users see the environment's resources and their properties; 'exclude-from-layout' applies the layout to all grains except the listed ones.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Values provided by the user, API or CI when creating an environment. Reference them anywhere in the blueprint as {{ .inputs.name }}.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.description: Values returned to the user/API when the environment is active, typically mapped from grain outputs: value: '{{ .grains.<grain>.outputs.<output> }}'.

env_references.title: Environment References
env_references.description: References to other running (published) environments, selected by labels. Grains can consume the referenced environments' outputs.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Inventory resource requirements reserved exclusively for the environment for its whole duration. Each requirement is either abstract ('selector' - Torque picks matching resources) or concrete ('reference' - specific resource reference ids). Grains access the assigned resources via {{ .resources.<name> }}.

grains.title: Grains
grains.description: Grains are the basic building blocks of a blueprint - each utilizes an infrastructure-as-code asset (Terraform module, Helm chart, shell script, nested blueprint...) or automation process to orchestrate part of the environment. Ordering is controlled with depends-on.

service_account.description: Email of the service account whose identity the environment's auto-minted Torque API token assumes. The presence of this section with a non-empty service_account requests API access.

family.title: Blueprint Family
family.description: Marks this YAML as a blueprint family; 'members' maps member names to their blueprint sources.

template.title: Blueprint Template
template.description: Marks this blueprint as a template. Each placeholder points at a YAML path ('path') the author must fill when creating a blueprint from the template, with an optional 'hint'.

Torque-Blueprint-Spec2.title: Torque Blueprint Spec 2
Torque-Blueprint-Spec2.description: A Torque environment blueprint (spec_version 2). Most values support Liquid templating: {{ .inputs.name }} or {{ .inputs.["Name With Spaces"] }}, {{ .grains.<grain>.outputs.<output> }}, {{ .params.<param> }}, dynamic values like {{ envId }}, {{ environmentName }}, {{ ownerEmail }}, {{ spaceName }}, and filters such as {{ value | downcase }}.

kind.description: The asset type this grain deploys.

depends-on.description: Comma-separated grain names that must complete before this grain starts; their outputs then become available to this grain via Liquid.

tf-version.description: Terraform version used to deploy the module (terraform grains). Prefer quoting the value: unquoted YAML floats are lossy (1.50 becomes 1.5), which silently changes the version.

when.description: Controls whether the grain runs or is skipped: if this Liquid expression evaluates to false, Torque skips the grain.

GrainScripts.description: Lifecycle hook scripts around the asset's deploy: Terraform (pre-tf-*), OpenTofu (pre-tofu-*), Helm, Kubernetes, Ansible and AWS CDK steps.

arguments.description: One line of space-separated arguments passed to the script.

Backend.description: Terraform/OpenTofu state backend configuration (s3, gcs, azurerm, http, remote, cloud).

TemplateStorage.description: CloudFormation: S3 bucket the template is uploaded to.

outputs.description: Output names the script exports (export name=value).

disable-tags-for.description: Resource types to exclude from auto-tagging (e.g. aws_s3_bucket_object).

GrainTag.description: Controls Torque's automatic tagging of deployed cloud resources.

type.description: 'manual' (run on demand), 'event' (run on the listed environment events) or 'cron' (run on a schedule). Workflows with scope 'space' support only 'manual' triggers.

event.description: Environment events that fire the workflow.

groups.description: For manual triggers: only users in these groups can run the workflow.

overridable.description: For cron triggers: allow end users to override the cron schedule.

AnsibleOnDestroy.description: Ansible: a separate playbook to run at environment teardown.

attributes.description: Provider attribute overrides; values may be scalars, nested mappings or lists.

provider-overrides.description: Terraform provider requirement/attribute overrides ({name, source, version, attributes}).

auto-approve.description: Apply the plan without manual approval (default true). With 'auto-approve: false' the run pauses for manual plan approval, which requires runner storage ('use-storage' must not be false).

target.description: A Torque Target: a named deployment context bundling the credential AND the agent - replaces 'agent' + 'authentication' (defining both 'agent' and 'target' is a validation error). Short form: target: <name>.

inputs.description: Values passed to the asset, as a list of name: value pairs, e.g. - vpc_id: '{{ .inputs.vpc }}'.

workspace-directories.description: Extra directories copied into the workspace ('name' on the source is required).

outputs.description: Asset output names to expose on the grain - outputs expose information about the deployed environment. Consume them as {{ .grains.<grain>.outputs.<name> }}.

commands.description: Helm: commands to run before installing the chart (e.g. dep up ./chart).

command-arguments.description: Extra command-line arguments appended to the asset's deploy command.

env-vars.description: Environment variables accessible only during this grain's lifecycle (deploy and destroy).

target-namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace to install into (helm grains).

authentication.description: Credential-store credential names used to deploy. Not needed when the grain uses 'target' - the target supplies the credential.

region.description: CloudFormation: AWS region to deploy the stack in.

version.description: Runtime version, e.g. the Terraform version to use. Prefer quoting the value: unquoted YAML floats are lossy (1.50 becomes 1.5), which silently changes the version.

auto-retry.description: Retry the deployment automatically on failure (default true).

tfvars-files.description: Terraform .tfvars files passed to the module.

opentofuvars-files.description: OpenTofu vars files passed to the module.

mode.description: Grain lifecycle mode. Terraform grains: 'managed' (default) or 'no-termination'; ArgoCD grains: 'data' (mandatory).

deployment-engine.description: Name of the deployment engine to execute this grain on.

target-resource.description: Terraform -target addresses: limit the run to these resources/modules.

stack-name-prefix.description: CloudFormation: prefix for the stack name.

ShellGrainFiles.description: Files downloaded to the shell grain's working directory, where commands can run them directly by name (they all land in one directory). 'source' is the repository in your space that contains the file, 'path' the relative path within it.

ActivitiesObject.description: Shell grain lifecycle: 'deploy' commands run during environment launch, 'destroy' commands during teardown.

commands.description: Commands to run in order - plain strings, or {name, command, outputs} objects to capture outputs.

outputs.description: Output names captured from environment variables EXPORTED by the command (export name=value; echo is NOT captured). Empty exports are dropped - if a value may be blank, export a non-empty sentinel instead.

GrainLabels.description: Labels applied to the environment when this grain ends: 'on-success' and/or 'on-failure'.

GrainConditionObject.description: A gate evaluated before the grain deploys. Type 'approval' pauses the environment until one of the channels approves.

EnvironmentLabelsArray.title: Environment Labels Array
EnvironmentLabelsArray.description: Labels as plain strings or single-entry {name: value} mappings.

TemplateParamsObject.description: Static template params exposed as params.* in Liquid expressions.
TemplateParamsObject.title: Template Params

key.description: Taint key that the toleration applies to. Omit together with an 'Exists' operator to tolerate all taints.

operator.description: 'Equal' matches the taint key to the given value, 'Exists' matches the key regardless of its value.

value.description: Taint value to match. Required when the operator is 'Equal'.

effect.description: Taint effect to tolerate. Leave empty to tolerate all effects.

toleration-seconds.description: For a 'NoExecute' taint, how long the pod stays bound to the node after the taint is added.

GrainInput.title: Grain Input
GrainInput.description: A single name: value pair passed to the asset.

GrainOutput.title: Grain Output
GrainOutput.description: An asset output name to expose on the grain.

name.description: The agent name; often an input, e.g. '{{ .inputs.agent }}'.

service-account.description: Kubernetes service account for the runner (e.g. annotated with a role ARN).

runner-namespace.description: The namespace where the runner pod will be provisioned.

storage-size.description: Required storage capacity in MB for the grain.

isolated.description: Whether the grain should run in isolation (overrides the runner default).

use-storage.description: Enable persistent storage for the runner. Cannot be false when 'auto-approve' is false - the plan must persist while awaiting approval.

GrainSpecHostObject.title: Spec Host Properties
GrainSpecHostObject.description: The Torque agent (execution host) that runs the grain, with optional runner customization. Mutually exclusive with 'target'.

KubernetesObject.description: Kubernetes runner job customization: pod labels/annotations, node selector, tolerations, permissions.

store.description: The name of the repository (asset store) the source comes from.

path.description: Location of the asset's code inside the store; for public sources a full URL is allowed.

branch.description: Git branch to take the source from (default: the repository's configured branch).

tag.description: Git tag to pin the source to.

commit.description: Commit SHA to pin the source to.

name.description: Name for the fetched source (required for workspace-directories).

BlueprintInputObject.title: Blueprint Input Object

parameter-name.description: For type 'parameter': takes the input's value from the parameter store, from the parameter with this name.

type.description: 'string' (default), 'agent' (pick an execution agent), 'credentials' (pick a credential), 'parameter' (bind to a parameter-store parameter), 'input-source' (values fetched from an input source), 'file' (upload files), 'dictionary' (key/value map), 'target' (pick a deployment target = credential + agent), 'resource' (pick inventory resources).

style.description: Defines how the input is presented to the user: 'text' (default), 'radio', 'multi-select' (select multiple values) or 'duration'.

description.description: In the relevant UI field, enter a description to be displayed to the user.

default.description: Value used when no other value is provided; pre-fills the launch-form field but never affects required-ness (required = no 'pattern'). A non-empty default must itself satisfy the pattern. 'default: ""' is a real empty-string default on a still-required field, not 'optional' - use a '^$|' pattern for that.

sensitive.description: Masks the value behind asterisks in the UI and API (default false). The launch form pre-fills sensitive inputs empty regardless of any default, so a sensitive input is only optional with an empty-matching pattern. The value is write-only after launch: environment responses omit it, it cannot be copied from the UI, and Relaunch does not carry it over - the user must re-enter it.

pattern.description: A regular expression the input value must match, enforced client-side in the launch form. The form marks an input REQUIRED if and only if it has no pattern; to make an input optional (blank allowed), use a pattern that matches the empty string - convention: a leading '^$|' alternative. Note that 'default: ""' does NOT make an input optional.

validation-description.description: A user-friendly message shown when the value doesn't match 'pattern' (e.g. 'Empty or a URL').

allowed-values.description: Converts the input into a dropdown list the end user selects from (a single-value list is auto-selected). API launches must pass the exact string.

searchable.description: When true, indicates that the input source supports search. The UI will collect a search pattern from the user before querying allowed values.

depends-on.description: Comma-separated input names this input depends on; it is re-evaluated when they change (cascading inputs; supported for parameter, input-source and resource types).

source-name.description: For type 'input-source': the input source whose evaluation supplies the allowed values.

target_name.description: Reserved override: a Target name whose Discovery-capability credential/agent the evaluation uses instead of explicit credential/agent overrides.

overrides.description: Overrides for the input source's parameters; only parameters the source marked overridable can be set.

max-size-MB.description: File inputs: maximum size per file, in MB.

max-files.description: File inputs: maximum number of files.

allowed-credential-providers.description: Credentials inputs: restrict the selectable credentials to these provider types.

resource-selector.description: Selection criteria constraining which inventory resources may be chosen for an input of type 'resource'. Mandatory for 'resource' inputs. Field values may use Liquid expressions.

BlueprintInputObject.description: A launch-form input. Required unless it has an empty-matching 'pattern' - see the 'pattern' and 'default' fields for the exact semantics.

value.description: Liquid expression producing the output value, e.g. '{{ .grains.db.outputs.hostname }}'.

quick.description: Present the output in the environment's Quick Access section.

sensitive.description: True if the output value is sensitive (e.g. a password). Affects only how the value is displayed in the UI - the value itself is still sent as-is.

labels-selector.description: Label selector matching the environment to reference (e.g. 'env=dev').

selector.description: Selection criteria constraining which inventory resources may be chosen for the requirement

oneOf.description: One or more inventory resource reference ids to reserve for the requirement, as a single reference id or a JSON-array string of reference ids. Liquid expressions are allowed.

ids.description: A single resource reference id or a JSON-array string of reference ids. Liquid expressions are allowed.

BlueprintResourceRequirementObject.title: Blueprint Resource Requirement
BlueprintResourceRequirementObject.description: One resource requirement. Exactly one of 'selector' (abstract) or 'reference' (concrete) must be set. The assigned resources are exposed to grains as {{ .resources.<name> }}.

ResourceSelectorBaseObject.$comment: Shared selection criteria for resource selectors, inherited via allOf by referencing objects. Deliberately does not set 'additionalProperties', so that it stays open for the inheritors to extend.

attributes.description: name: value attributes the resources must have. Values may be Liquid (root blueprint only).

ResourceSelectorObject.$comment: Extends ResourceSelectorBaseObject with 'quantity'. The inherited properties are re-listed here with empty schemas ({}) only so that 'additionalProperties': false does not reject them: 'additionalProperties' considers only the 'properties' declared in the same schema object and is blind to those coming from the $ref'd base. If this schema is ever moved to draft 2019-09 or later, delete these stubs and replace 'additionalProperties': false with 'unevaluatedProperties': false.

quantity.description: How many resources to reserve. Omitted = exactly one (grains see a single object); with quantity N (even 1) grains see a list.

ResourceSelectorObject.title: Blueprint Resource Selector

BlueprintInputResourceSelectorObject.$comment: Extends ResourceSelectorBaseObject, adding no fields of its own - notably no 'quantity', which is a resource-requirement concern. See the $comment on ResourceSelectorObject for why the inherited properties are re-listed with empty schemas ({}).
BlueprintInputResourceSelectorObject.title: Blueprint Input Resource Selector

StoreFileSourceObject.title: Store File Source
StoreFileSourceObject.description: A file from a connected repository: 'store' is the repository name, 'path' the file path in it.

inputs.description: Legacy: input customizations directly under customization.

layout.description: Dynamic environment dashboard layout (cards/categories). Loosely validated.

grains-map.description: Designer canvas layout (node positions, sticky notes, rectangles, groups); typically generated by the Torque designer. Node types: 'grain' (id must match a grain name), 'note' (sticky note, fixed size), 'rectangle' (sized zone); use ASCII-only text in note/label content.

CustomizationObject.description: Torque UI customization. May be embedded in the blueprint YAML or stored per space via the customization API; the server treats it as opaque content interpreted by the Torque UI.

image.description: Image URL (https:// or data:image/) shown on the launch form.

LaunchFormObject.title: Launch Form Object
LaunchFormObject.description: Controls the visibility and organization of input fields in the environment launch form: group inputs into categories and sections, hide inputs or steps, add images and action buttons.

httpmethod.description: HTTP method for the action: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE or PATCH (case-insensitive). Defaults to GET.

name.description: The name of the input field

header.description: Comma separated header for object input type

allow-refresh.description: Show or hide refresh button next to Input-Source type input

visible.description: Conditional visibility expression using Liquid template syntax

display_name.description: Display name override for the input.

allowed-values-details.description: Per-allowed-value details map (value -> details object), or a list of such maps.

visible.description: Step visibility flag or Liquid expression

LaunchFormStepsObject.title: Launch Form Steps Object
LaunchFormStepsObject.description: Show or hide the launch form's built-in steps.

initial-color.description: Initial label color (can be changed later in the UI).

initial-quick-filter.description: Initially show the label as a quick filter in the catalog.

name.description: The display name of the category

description.description: Descriptive text shown under the category

LaunchFormSectionObject.description: A section whose inputs are all 'visible: false' still renders as an empty header - keep at least one visible input in it, or remove the section.

name.description: The display name of the section

description.description: Descriptive text shown under the section

default_open.description: Whether the section should be expanded by default

type.description: Special section type, for example duration

LaunchFormSectionObject.title: Launch Form Section Object

name.description: The target name; often an input, e.g. '{{ .inputs.my_target }}'.

RunnerConfigurationOverrideObject.title: Runner Configuration Override Object
RunnerConfigurationOverrideObject.description: Overrides the runner configuration of the target's agent for this grain.

cloud-providers.description: Filter targets by cloud provider type (e.g. aws, azure). OR logic

cloud-identifiers.description: Filter targets by cloud account identifier. OR logic

labels.description: Filter targets by labels. AND logic — target must have ALL specified key-value label pairs.
